name: bank-base
description: A made-up bank's standard specification on top of SDEM — the base every team's profile extends (synthetic; not a real organisation's).

types.name: Payments microservice
types.definition: An independently deployable payments service owned by one team

types.name: Control function
types.definition: A capability whose purpose is a regulatory or risk control

attributes.name: cost_centre
attributes.description: the cost centre that pays for it

attributes.name: owning_team
attributes.description: the team that owns the service

attributes.name: requirement_class
attributes.description: functional (what the business must be able to do) or non-functional (how well — measured in requirements.json); SDEM's own requirement_kind stays ArchiMate's requirement / constraint / principle

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: the regulation or policy clause it comes from

attributes.name: dr_tier
attributes.description: the disaster recovery tier (1: hot standby)

attributes.name: dr_region
attributes.description: the region it runs in, for DR separation

attributes.name: replication_mode
attributes.description: how its data reaches the DR pair

rules.message: every application names its owner and risk tier (bank application standard §3)
every production platform states its DR tier, region and replication (bank resilience standard §5)
a tier 1 or 2 production platform has a DR pair (bank resilience standard §5.2)
a platform and its DR pair run in different regions (bank resilience standard §5.3)

requirement_categories.description: tolerance for disruption of a critical operation (synthetic)

link_kinds.description: a platform and the platform it fails over to
an infrastructure component is operated by a management platform
